title: The Last Border Revisited
author: A. M. Underhill
blurb: Petra Villalobos, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
